company.name: Prayas Analytics
company.shortDescription: Prayas Analytics helps brick-and-mortar retailers A/B test their stores, all using existing security cameras.
company.description:
Prayas Anaytics helps retailers A/B test their stores, the way eCommerce companies A/B test their websites. This is done by continuously collecting data on customer movement using existing security cameras already in a retailer's stores.

Prayas Analytics is a Y Combinator backed company (S15) and is currently working with several retailers including Barneys, Payomatic, and multiple Fortune 200 retailers. The company has been featured in VentureBeat, The National Retail Federation, and Techcrunch.

Visit www.prayasanalytics.com for more information.
